name: Adaptive Offset Masking
aliases: Learnable Binary Masking for Anchors and Offsets
definition: A pruning strategy using learnable binary masks to eliminate invalid Gaussians and anchors, integrated into rate calculation for adaptive updates without extra loss terms.
summary: Adaptive Offset Masking is a pruning strategy using learnable binary masks to eliminate invalid Gaussians, dynamically adjusting the mask ratio via backpropagation to balance fidelity and bit consumption.
